  [numberLine] សរុប is shown on number line with a green line broken into two sections, ពណ៌លឿង on ឆ្វេង and ពណ៌ខៀវ 
               on ស្តាំ. A movable knob changes how សរុប is broken apart by changing lengths of ពណ៌លឿង and ពណ៌ខៀវ 
               sections. Number spinners add one or remove one from ពណ៌លឿង or ពណ៌ខៀវ section. An addition phrase, { a11y_numberBondOrBarModelLowercase }, and equation represent how two numbers 
               add to សរុប. Additionally, create totals from { $min } to { $max } or swap addends.
  *[other] There are ពណ៌លឿង and ពណ៌ខៀវ { $representation } you can move to organize or change color to find 
           different ways to create a សរុប number of { $representation }. An addition phrase, { a11y_numberBondOrBarModelLowercase }, and equation represent how two numbers 
           add to សរុប. Additionally, create totals from { $min } to { $max }, automatically organize objects, or swap addends.
}

a11y.tenOrTwentyScreen.screenSummary.pla.value:
{ $representationType ->
  [numberLine] There is a number line showing សរុប as a green line broken into two sections, ពណ៌លឿង on ឆ្វេង and ពណ៌ខៀវ on ស្តាំ. A movable knob changes how សរុប is broken apart by changing lengths of ពណ៌លឿង and ពណ៌ខៀវ sections. A decomposition phrase, { a11y_numberBondOrBarModelLowercase }, and equation represent how សរុប is broken  apart into two addends. Additionally, choose any សរុប from { $min } to { $max } or swap addends.
  [beads] There are movable ពណ៌លឿង and ពណ៌ខៀវ beads you can slide along a wire to organize or change color to change how សរុប is broken apart. A decomposition phrase, { a11y_numberBondOrBarModelLowercase }, and equation represent how សរុប is broken  apart into two addends. Additionally, choose any សរុប from { $min } to { $max }, automatically organize  objects, or swap addends.
  [kittens] There are freely movable ពណ៌លឿង and ពណ៌ខៀវ kittens you can organize or change color to change how សរុប is broken apart. A decomposition phrase, { a11y_numberBondOrBarModelLowercase }, and equation represent how សរុប is broken  apart into two addends. Additionally, choose any សរុប from { $min } to { $max }, automatically organize  objects, or swap addends.
  *[location] { a11y_playAreaIntroSentence } Additionally, choose any សរុប from { $min } to { $max }, automatically organize  objects, or swap addends.
}
